security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation URLs, and Tailwind examples. I confirmed execution risk for the bundled Bash migration script and added a semantic finding because it installs packages and edits project files. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The migration script changes project files and installs packages when run.
remediation.suggestion: Add a dry-run mode, explicit confirmation prompts, package version pinning, and clear rollback instructions before recommending execution.

remediation.issue: The script removes tailwind.config.js during cleanup.
remediation.suggestion: Move deletion behind a separate confirmation step or rename the file after writing migrated configuration guidance.

remediation.issue: Status messages call basename with an unquoted file variable.
remediation.suggestion: Quote basename arguments and run shellcheck to reduce path handling errors in unusual filenames.

content.value_statement: Tailwind CSS V4 changes configuration, migration steps, and performance choices. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured guidance for safer upgrades and better CSS architecture.
actual_capabilities: Explains Tailwind CSS V4 architecture and CSS-first configuration patterns.
Guides migrations from Tailwind v3 to v4 with breaking-change checks.
Designs theme variables, component classes, and multi-brand styling systems.
Recommends Vite, PostCSS, or CLI integration based on project needs.
Troubleshoots common utility renames, opacity changes, border changes, and ring changes.
Provides performance tuning guidance for Oxide builds and hot reload workflows.
limitations: Focused on Tailwind CSS V4, not older Tailwind versions or general CSS lessons.
Migration advice still needs testing in the target project before release.
The included shell script can change files and should be reviewed before use.
Browser compatibility guidance depends on current Tailwind and browser support.

use_cases.title: Migrate an Existing App
use_cases.description: Plan a Tailwind v3 to v4 upgrade, identify breaking changes, and define validation steps.

use_cases.title: Build a Design System
use_cases.description: Create CSS-first theme variables, component conventions, and brand-aware styling patterns.

use_cases.title: Improve Build Performance
use_cases.description: Select the right Tailwind V4 integration and measure build, reload, and CSS size improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Tailwind V4 Basics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner learning the main changes in Tailwind CSS V4.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the most important Tailwind CSS V4 changes for my project. Cover CSS-first configuration, browser requirements, and common migration risks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Developer preparing to upgrade an existing Tailwind v3 project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Tailwind v3 to v4 migration. Ask for my build tool, custom config, browser targets, and components before giving steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Theme System
prompt_templates.scenario: Team creating reusable Tailwind V4 styling foundations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Tailwind CSS V4 theme system for a component library. Include variable strategy, component naming, dark mode, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Production Builds
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user tuning Tailwind V4 build performance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Tailwind CSS V4 performance setup. Compare Vite, PostCSS, and CLI choices, then propose measurement and optimization steps.

output_examples.input: I need to migrate a Tailwind v3 app that uses custom colors and opacity utilities.
output_examples.output: A migration checklist covering dependency updates, CSS import changes, theme variable conversion, opacity replacements, and visual regression checks.

output_examples.input: Help me create a multi-brand Tailwind V4 component system.
output_examples.output: A design plan with brand tokens, theme boundaries, component class conventions, dark mode handling, and documentation tasks.

output_examples.input: My Tailwind V4 build is slower than expected.
output_examples.output: A performance review plan that checks plugin choice, theme size, breakpoint count, source maps, and baseline measurements.

best_practices: Start each migration with an inventory of custom config, browser targets, and high-risk components.
Keep Tailwind V4 theme variables small, explicit, and documented in CSS.
Test visual changes for borders, rings, shadows, rounded corners, and opacity replacements.
anti_patterns: Do not assume Tailwind v3 JavaScript config controls V4 projects.
Do not run the migration script without reviewing its file edits and package installs.
Do not optimize build performance before measuring a baseline.

faq.question: Does this skill support Tailwind v3?
faq.answer: It focuses on Tailwind CSS V4. It can explain migration from v3, but it is not a full v3 reference.

faq.question: Can it run the migration automatically?
faq.answer: The package includes a shell script, but users should review it and test on a branch before running it.

faq.question: Does it help with design systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers CSS variables, component layers, theme structure, dark mode, and multi-brand patterns.

faq.question: Does it include performance advice?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains plugin selection, Oxide behavior, build measurement, and common performance pitfalls.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users verify after migration?
faq.answer: Users should verify browser targets, visual changes, removed utilities, theme variables, and production build output.
